content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-14. - Materials prepared by engineer.
content.summary:
The engineer shall forthwith prepare and file with the clerk the:
(1)
Preliminary plans;
(2)
Preliminary estimate of costs; and
(3)
Assessment plat.
(Code 1981, § 27-15; Ord. No. 551, § 8(F), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 766, § 3, 6-16-1969)
